module.purpose: Defines the team profile settings route, generating localized metadata and rendering the legacy team profile view within the shared settings shell.
module.summary: This route adapter connects the application-router settings path to an existing team profile implementation. It resolves localized profile labels and descriptions, builds route-aware metadata using the team identifier, and places the legacy view inside the standard settings header component.
module.businessContext: Supports team administrators viewing and managing a team's profile settings. Failure prevents the team profile page and its localized metadata from rendering.
functions: generateMetadata (~L6-13): Builds localized metadata for the team profile route
Page (~L15-27): Renders the team profile inside settings navigation chrome

units.name: generateMetadata
units.source:
export const generateMetadata = async ({ params }: { params: Promise<{ id: string }> }) =>
  await _generateMetadata(
    (t) => t("profile"),
    (t) => t("profile_team_description"),
    undefined,
    undefined,
    `/settings/teams/${(await params).id}/profile`
  );

detail.name: generateMetadata
detail.signature: export const generateMetadata = async ({ params }: { params: Promise<{ id: string }> }) =>
preconditions: The input contains a params property resolving to an object with a string id.
postconditions: The returned promise resolves to the value produced by _generateMetadata.
_generateMetadata is invoked with profile-specific title and description translation callbacks and the pathname /settings/teams/{id}/profile.
invariants: The title translation callback requests the profile key.
The description translation callback requests the profile_team_description key.
The metadata pathname is constructed using the resolved id without additional transformation.
edgeCases: When params resolves with an empty string id, the pathname contains the empty segment /settings/teams//profile.
When params rejects, the function rejects without producing metadata.
When _generateMetadata rejects, the function rejects with that dependency error.
detail.summary: Generates the profile page metadata for a team settings route. It resolves the team identifier from the asynchronous route parameters and delegates metadata construction with profile-specific translation keys and pathname.
